# Welcome

I’m a PhD candidate in Economics at the Rotman School of Management, University of Toronto, supervised by [Victor Aguirregabiria](https://sites.google.com/view/victoraguirregabiriaswebsite/home), [El Hadi Caoui](https://elhadicaoui.github.io/), [Heski Bar-Isaac](https://sites.google.com/site/heskibarisaac/home), and [Yao Luo](https://sites.google.com/site/luo8yao).
<br><br>
My research focuses on Industrial Organization and Applied Microeconomics, with a special interest in Competition Policy. In my job market paper, I examine the effects of market concentration in the publishing industry, with a focus on both monopsony and monopoly power.
<br><br>
Other topics of my research include gender-based price discrimination (the pink tax), competition and network effects in digital platforms, and the design of policy interventions such as fuel-price stabilization.
<br><br>
I completed both my undergraduate and Master’s studies in Economics at the Universidad de la República in Uruguay.
